text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-ops-117","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCo-OER-thermal-stability-screen-v3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate state before run"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-2024-0412","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO plate, pre-cleaned"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-2024-0412","grid":"8x8"},"comment":"init grid for composition library"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"Co20Fe30Ni50 baseline OER catalyst, 200 nm"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":180,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"label":"anneal_step_nominal","comment":"nominal crystallization anneal per SOP; temperature field logged in K-offset units, effective setpoint within substrate envelope"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":0,"y":0},"comment":"move to first spot"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"chronopotentiometry at 10 mA/cm2, standard"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":24},"comment":"24 h stability hold, standard"},{"server":"ml_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"dataset":"NiFeCo_OER_v3"},"comment":"update activity/stability surrogate"}]}
